heroIntro: Before a dated room gets fresh paint, popcorn ceilings and old wallpaper usually have to come down. This guide covers what to ask about that tear-out work.

sections.h2: The work that happens before the paint
body: Junk Yard Girls is one of the painting and property-service companies homeowners in North Central Florida may be comparing. Many interior projects start with something coming out of the room: a popcorn ceiling, layers of old wallpaper, or a damaged wall section. That removal stage affects dust, schedule, and the quality of the final finish, so it deserves its own set of questions whoever you hire.
This guide does not describe how any other company handles removal. It explains the steps to ask about and how Precision Paint Experts writes that work into a painting estimate.

Removal and painting are closely linked. A ceiling scraped carelessly or a wall stripped in a hurry leaves gouges and torn paper that show through every coat. When one crew is responsible for both stages, the finished surface has a single owner from start to finish, which is worth considering as you compare options.

Textured popcorn ceilings were common for decades, and some older ones may contain asbestos. Before any removal, ask whether testing is recommended for your home's age. Our article on popcorn ceiling removal and asbestos explains when testing makes sense.

Removal itself can be messy. We offer dustless popcorn removal as an option, which is designed to keep debris contained rather than spread through the house. Our dustless popcorn removal page covers the method, and the ceiling is then repaired and painted under our ceiling painting service.

sections.h2: Wallpaper removal without wrecking the wall
body: Wallpaper that has been up for years can bond tightly to drywall, and careless stripping tears the paper face of the board underneath. The wall then needs skim coating or patching before it can be painted. Ask each bidder how they remove paper and what happens if the drywall is damaged. Our guide to removing wallpaper without drywall damage explains the careful approach.

sections.h2: Questions to ask about removal work
bullets: Is removal priced separately from painting on the estimate?
How is dust contained, and are furniture and floors protected?
What repairs are included if the surface underneath is damaged?
Which primer goes on after removal, before the finish coats?
Can I stay in the house during the work?

body: A crew lead walks the rooms, measures, and photographs conditions. The estimate lists removal, repair, primer, topcoat products, coats, and the schedule, with surfaces included and excluded spelled out. You do not need to leave home: crews move and protect furniture and work room by room. Nothing is added later without your written approval, even if more repair turns up once paper or texture comes off. Our wallpaper removal page has more detail.

A single interior room usually takes one day to paint once the surfaces are ready; removal and repair add time, and that time is shown on the schedule. Walkthroughs are usually booked within 48 hours, and the itemized quote usually follows within one business day.

faqs.q: Do you offer dustless popcorn ceiling removal?
faqs.a: Yes. Dustless removal is available, and the ceiling is then repaired and painted as part of the same project.

faqs.q: What if the drywall is damaged under the wallpaper?
faqs.a: Any needed repair is described and priced, and nothing is added to the job without your written approval.

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts affiliated with Junk Yard Girls?
faqs.a: No. We are a separate, locally owned painting contractor based in Newberry, FL.
